features.quote: Max 50 turns per episode or until induction confirmed + 5-turn grace window.
Token Ceiling: 24,000 cumulative tokens (input + output). Breach triggers `EXPLODE` phenotype and force-terminates.
Per-Turn Generation Cap: 4,096 tokens. Three consecutive hits of this cap flag `PRESSURE` pre-induction state.
If induction flags persist for 3 consecutive turns, enter Grace Window (5 turns) to capture severity. After grace window, episode terminates to control cost.
Computes rolling state vectors at every turn boundary.
